bug.title: Loopback retry and command replacement can hide failure
bug.summary: The supplied loopback evidence records a failed first attempt followed by pass, three automatic retries, and an environment command that can replace the complete suite; this is not safe release evidence.

steps: Run a deterministic loopback command that fails once and passes on retry.
Run with the suite replacement environment variable and inspect the reported status.
reproduction.observed: GATE-SOURCE runs the fixed loopback command once, rejects CSSWITCH_LOOPBACK_TEST_CMD authority, and has no retry policy.

confirmed_facts.statement: The supplied v0.8.3 audit records a failed first loopback attempt followed by recovery and suite-replacement risk.
GATE-SOURCE runs the fixed loopback command once, rejects CSSWITCH_LOOPBACK_TEST_CMD authority, and has no retry policy.
